active_ingredient: ACTIVE INGREDIENTS: Aconitum Napellus 30C, Anas Barbariae 30C, Bryonia 30C, Eupatorium Perfoliatum 30C, Gelsemium Sempervirens 30C, Influenzinum 30C, Ipecacuanha 30C, Nux Vomica 30C, Phosphorus 30C, Phytolacca Decandra 30C, Sanguinaria Canadensis 30C, Sticta Pulmonaria 30C.
purpose: PURPOSE: Aconitum Napellus – dizziness, fever, Anas Barbariae – general flu symptoms, Bryonia – body aches, sinus pain, Eupatorium Perfoliatum – body aches, couch, Gelsemium Sempervirens – chills, fever, fatigue, Influenzinum – general flu symptoms, Ipecacuanha – nausea, vomiting, Nux Vomica – headache, nausea, Phosphorus – congestion, fatigue, Phytolacca Decandra – congestion, sore throat, Sanguinaria Canadensis – diarrhea, headache, Sticta Pulmonaria – cough, sore throat* *This product has not been tested or the uses evaluated by the FDA.
indications_and_usage: USES: Reduce duration and severity of flu-like symptoms.* *This product has not been tested or the uses evaluated by the FDA.
warnings: WARNINGS: Sore throat warning: Severe or persistent sore throat or sore throat accompanied by high fever, headache, nausea, and vomiting may be serious. Consult physician promptly. Do not use more that 2 days or administer to children under 3 years of age unless directed by physician. If symptoms worsen or persist for more than 3 days consult a doctor. If Pregnant or breastfeeding consult a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Use only if safety seal is intact. Store at room temperature.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS: At first sign of the flu take 3 times per day for symptom relief and once per week for maintenance. Place drops under tongue or mix with 1oz of water. Adults: 20 drops per dose. Children: Age 2+: 2 drops for every 10 pounds of body weight up to 20 drops per dose. Best taken away from food.
inactive_ingredient: INACTIVE INGREDIENTS: Organic ethanol 20% (v/v), USP purified water
